reviews.review_description: I tried PADEL 01 the day after its early access launch, and it’s clear there’s real passion for the sport behind it. Playing in mixed reality, with your own room turning into the court, is an idea that works. What I really appreciate is that you can adjust the size of the court, so it adapts well even if you don’t have much space to play, which isn’t a given with similar games on the store. You can tell it’s an early-stage project, but the foundations are solid and the developer seems to listen to players. I’ll keep an eye on it and keep playing as it grows. Recommended if you love padel or want something different in your headset!

developer_response.body: Thank you so much, Marmos! Really glad the mixed reality court and the adjustable court size work well in your space. We're in Early Access and building PADEL 01 with players, so any feedback is welcome in our Discord: https://discord.gg/Ra2DKZM89Z. See you on court! 🎾

reviews.review_title: Fantastic Padel Simulation in VR & MR!
reviews.review_description:
PADEL 01 is an excellent padel simulation that really delivers! Whether you want to play 1-on-1, take on 2-on-2 matches, or spend time practising with drills over and over, there's plenty to keep you busy.

The physics are spot on, and one of my favourite aspects is how naturally the ball interacts with the glass walls. Bouncing the ball off the glass feels incredibly satisfying, smooth, and responsive. It really makes a difference when you're trying to master your shots and improve your game.

You can play in either VR or Mixed Reality, which is another great addition. Being able to bring the court into your own environment adds a different dimension to the experience.

And don't underestimate the bots! They're definitely not there just to look good. They'll make you work hard for every single point, forcing you to improve your positioning, timing, and shot selection. Winning a match actually feels rewarding!

What impressed me most is just how smooth the whole experience is. The physics, responsiveness, and overall execution make this a very convincing padel experience in VR.

If you're a padel enthusiast or simply curious about the sport, PADEL 01 is absolutely worth checking out.

Grab your racket, get moving, and get ready for some serious competition.

Padel time it is!!! Highly recommended! 🎾

reviews.review_title: Brilliant Padel Sim in the Making
reviews.review_description: A great foundation for a brilliant game. You can tell the developer loves padel in real life. He really listens to feedback, and has progress has been rapid. It’s great how you can play within your own playspace, the physics feel solid, and I'm really looking forward to multiplayer in the future.

developer_response.body: Thank you so much, Basilisk! Really glad the physics feel solid and that playing in your own space works for you. We're building PADEL 01 with player feedback, so keep it coming in our Discord: https://discord.gg/Ra2DKZM89Z. See you on court! 🎾

reviews.review_description: A great start to the launch of padel 01, i enjoy playing the drills and there's quite a lot of customised options in the set up menus, has great potential and for a early access game shows great promise !

developer_response.body: Thank you, True.Q! Really happy you're enjoying the drills and the setup options. Try the weekly drill and see where you land on the ranking. More improvements are on the way.

reviews.review_description: Still early in development, but already a fun experience. Looking forward to seeing how it evolves!

developer_response.body: Thanks so much, Castiel089! Glad you're already having fun. The latest update brought a new court and better hitting and glass physics, and there's a lot more coming. Feedback is always welcome in the PADEL 01 Discord.
